About Us

A Kolkata Atelier with a Heritage Heart

Founded in 2009 in a restored Ballygunge mansion, Atelier Ananya began with a single conviction — that the homes of Kolkata deserve interiors as storied as the city itself. Our studio pairs old-world craftsmanship with contemporary restraint.

Every project starts with listening. We study how you gather, rest, and celebrate — then translate those rituals into spaces of quiet luxury: hand-rubbed teak, terrazzo from Chandannagar mills, and light that moves through your day like a well-rehearsed raga.

“We don’t decorate rooms. We compose the backdrop of your life.”
Ananya Sen — Founder & Principal Designer

Residential Interiors

Commercial Spaces

Turnkey Execution

FAQ

Questions, Answered

What is the typical budget for a full-home interior project?

Most full-home projects in Kolkata range from ₹12 lakhs for a 2BHK to ₹60 lakhs and above for large heritage homes, depending on materials, custom joinery, and scope. After a free consultation and site visit, we provide a transparent line-item estimate — no hidden costs, ever.

How long does a complete interior project take?

A typical 3BHK turnkey project takes 10–14 weeks from design freeze to handover. Heritage restorations and commercial fit-outs vary between 12–20 weeks. You receive a milestone schedule in week one, and we share weekly photo progress reports.

Do you handle everything, or do we need separate contractors?

We are fully turnkey. Civil work, electricals, plumbing, carpentry, painting, false ceilings, and final styling are all executed by our in-house teams and vetted partners — under one contract, one timeline, and one point of accountability.

Can you design according to Vastu principles?

Absolutely. Many of our Kolkata clients request Vastu-aligned planning. Our designers integrate Vastu considerations into layout, kitchen placement, and entrance design without compromising on aesthetics or functionality.

Which areas of Kolkata do you serve?

We serve the entire Kolkata metropolitan region — including Alipore, Ballygunge, Salt Lake, New Town, Behala, Howrah, and beyond. Projects outside West Bengal are considered on a case-by-case basis.

Is the initial consultation really free?

Yes. Your first consultation — including a site visit within Kolkata and a preliminary mood direction — is completely complimentary with no obligation. Use the form below to book yours.
